_meta.description: Flagged irregularities and unverified items. Published on the Flagged for Review page. None of these block the merge (per the user's instruction). 'Needs review' means the user should decide.

flags.title: Category commission rate unverified (blank on all rows)
flags.detail: The official Standard Commission Income schedule is behind an Amazon sign-in. Third-party sites disagree (Kitchen is listed at 4.5% by one and 5% by another), so no rate was entered. Earnings and commission potential cannot be calculated until the rate is read from the schedule in an authenticated Associates account.
flags.action: Sign in to Associates Central, read the rate for the category Amazon assigns to these products, and send it for entry.

flags.title: Prices and star ratings withheld from the public site
flags.detail: Participation Requirements Section 2(b) allows prices and availability to be shown only if Amazon serves the link or the data comes from Creators API / PA API. Section 3(t) bars star ratings and review data unless obtained the same way. The verification read prices and ratings, but they are not published. The pricing and rating analysis the brief asks for therefore cannot be shown on a static site.
flags.action: Decide whether to (a) apply for PA-API / Creators API access, which requires review of its license terms (not reviewed in this pass), or (b) accept price and rating fields as withheld.

flags.title: Associates tag not visible in the resolved links
flags.detail: All three short links resolve to Amazon product URLs with tracking parameters (lv, channelId, plpRedirect, btn_ref) but no 'tag=' parameter. Commission attribution to the user's Associates ID therefore cannot be confirmed from the page.
flags.action: Confirm in Associates Central that each link was generated under the user's Associates ID. Send the tagged canonical URL if the short links do not carry the tag.

flags.title: Short-link codes do not match the ASINs they resolve to
flags.detail: The codes B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3 and B00hJ57DV are not ASINs. They resolve to B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R and B08DKYBTPH. The ASIN from the resolved URL is used everywhere on the site.
flags.action: Confirm each resolved ASIN is the intended product.

flags.title: Brand for P2 is ambiguous
flags.detail: The Emeril product page lists 'Visit the Emeril Store' and shows the byline 'Innovation IQ'. The brand is therefore left unresolved rather than assumed to be Emeril Lagasse.
flags.action: Confirm the brand/manufacturer from the product's 'Product information' section or the seller page.

flags.title: Capacity units differ between title and specification
flags.detail: P1 title says '6 Quart' but the specification says '6 liters'. P2 title says '26QT' but the specification says '24.6 liters'. Units were not converted, so the two values were left exactly as listed.
flags.action: Confirm the capacity the manufacturer states (quarts or liters) before using it in comparisons.

flags.title: Colour differs between title and specification (P1)
flags.detail: The title ends in 'Black'; the specification table lists 'Black, Gray'.
flags.action: Confirm the colour option the user intends to promote.

flags.title: P3 is a size-variant family
flags.detail: The P3 page offers size options of 6, 8 and 9 quarts. The short link resolves to the 8-quart variant (ASIN B08DKYBTPH, with variation parameter th=1). Capacity values on the site are for the 8-quart variant only.
flags.action: Confirm whether the user wants the 8-quart variant or the family.

flags.title: Snapshot was taken for a US delivery location
flags.detail: The product pages were read with a US delivery location set, so every field on the site reflects a US listing snapshot. The marketplace the campaign should target still needs to be confirmed, because the Associates Program is country-specific. Irregularity corrected in the 2026-11-14 re-verification pass: an earlier version of this flag stated the user's location as Bucharest, Romania. No source in this repository supports that statement and it contradicts the session context (US, Texas), so the claim has been removed rather than repeated.
flags.action: Confirm which Amazon marketplace (and which country's Associates Program) the links should target.

flags.title: Competitor carousel on P2 is labelled 'Sponsored'
flags.detail: The 'Customers who viewed this item also viewed' section on the P2 page is labelled 'Sponsored'. Competitor ASINs listed for P2 may therefore be paid placements, not organic recommendations.
flags.action: Treat P2's competitor list as a sponsored signal, not as organic competition data.

flags.title: Verification method may conflict with Amazon Conditions of Use
flags.detail: The Conditions of Use licence excludes collecting and using product listings, descriptions or prices, and excludes data mining and robots. This verification read product pages with an automated retrieval tool. The site keeps only identifiers, brand, category and a few specification fields, and does not publish prices or ratings. Scaling this approach (for example, automated product research) would need legal review.
flags.action: Review with counsel before any automated product research. Prefer PA-API / Creators API data or manual entry.

flags.title: AI content automation is restricted by Amazon Conditions of Use
flags.detail: The Conditions of Use bar using AI-generated content from Amazon Services to develop or improve large language or machine learning models. The planned AI article generation has therefore NOT been built. It must be reviewed before it is connected to any Amazon-derived data. Sharpened in the 2026-11-14 re-verification pass: the Associates Program Policies carry a second, more specific restriction — Participation Requirements Section 5 bars using Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology without Amazon's prior written approval (R-17). Both restrictions point the same way: no AI training or model improvement on Amazon-derived content.
flags.action: Decide the data sources for AI-generated articles and get a compliance review before automation.

flags.title: Prior GitHub Pages workflow failed; Pages now uses main /docs
flags.detail: The prior session's 'Deploy static site to GitHub Pages' workflow failed before creating any jobs (its deploy job referenced a step output in the job-level environment URL). The repository Pages build was a legacy build from main root. This integration replaces that workflow with a checks-only workflow and moves the Pages source to main /docs.
flags.status: Fixed in this integration; needs review
flags.action: Confirm the live site after merge.

flags.title: Prior prototype records superseded
flags.detail: The prototype pages from earlier sessions (root index.html, products.html, insights.html, flagged.html) held blank product records and an unverified status. They are replaced by the verified records in this site (git history keeps them).
flags.action: None.

flags.title: Trend, popularity and conversion signals are unverified
flags.detail: The product pages show Amazon's own merchandising badges and counts (a recommended-by-Amazon badge, a purchases-in-a-recent-window count, brand-level rating and order counts and a returns-rate note). These are not published, because reuse of Amazon-displayed sales and review metrics was not confirmed (F-02). No official source provides verified trend or conversion data for these products, so trend and conversion fields are blank. Confirmed again on the 2026-11-14 re-read of the P1 page: the brand-level module is present, and a sponsored module on the same page shows a recommended badge, a review count and a price for the P3 product. None of those figures are published here.
flags.action: Provide an official data source (for example, PA-API) or accept blank fields.

flags.title: Creators API / PA API license terms not reviewed
flags.detail: The Program Policies incorporate an 'Associates Program IP License and Usage Requirements' section that governs Creators API and PA API use. It was not read line by line in this pass, so no API integration is claimed.
flags.action: Read the IP License section before any API work.

flags.title: Specification-table fields were not re-read in the 2026-11-14 pass
flags.detail: The second, independent verification pass re-read each product page and re-confirmed the listing title, the brand byline, the category breadcrumb, the also-viewed ASINs and the absence of a tag parameter. The Product-information specification table (litre capacity, item dimensions, colour and material strings) did not appear in the rendered page text returned to this pass, so those four fields are carried forward from the earlier session's read and are marked 'carried forward', not 're-verified'. They are still shown on the site because the earlier session recorded them against the same official page.
flags.action: Re-open each listing and check the specification table by hand before the marketing drafts are published.

flags.title: 'Price analysis' in the brief conflicts with the ban on price tracking and alerting
flags.detail: The brief asks the platform to analyse pricing. Participation Requirements Section 3(y) says the Site must not have price tracking or price alerting functionality unless Amazon agrees otherwise, and Section 2(b) limits where prices may be shown at all (R-02, R-21). A pricing module is therefore not built into this site: it needs either Amazon's agreement or a clear scope that keeps price data off the Site entirely.
flags.action: Decide the pricing scope: drop on-site price display and keep analysis internal, or apply for written agreement from Amazon.

flags.title: AI-generated marketing copy must not train or improve any model
flags.detail: The platform goal is AI-generated articles, comparisons and buying guides. R-17 (Participation Requirements Section 5) bars using Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology without prior written approval, and the Conditions of Use bar the same for Amazon-derived AI-generated content (F-12). Draft copy in this repository is written for the site only; no model is trained on listing data. If a generation service is connected later, its provider terms must exclude training on the input.
flags.action: Confirm the generator's data-handling terms before connecting any automated content pipeline.

flags.title: Draft marketing copy carries no expiry or promotion controls
flags.detail: Marketing drafts here mention no prices, discounts or limited-time offers, which satisfies R-20 by avoidance. Once campaigns run, Amazon's rule requires the removal of promotion references as soon as the promotion ends; nothing in this repository performs that expiry yet.
flags.action: Add an expiry step (or a manual review cadence) before any promotion is mentioned on the Site.

flags.title: No Associates account or tag is confirmed in this environment
flags.detail: Participation Requirements Section 2(a) permits Special Links only after you have applied to the Associates Program (R-23). This session has no credentials and no evidence of an approved account or of an assigned Associates ID, and the resolved user-supplied links carry no tag parameter (F-03). The content is therefore published as drafts inside this research site, not as a live monetised page.
flags.action: Confirm the Associates ID, then regenerate each link as a tagged Special Link before publishing the drafts.

flags.title: Third-party brand page disagrees with the Amazon specification values
flags.detail: A brand manufacturer page for a similarly named 8-quart TurboFry model lists 15.4 x 12.6 x 13.5 in, while the Amazon listing for P3 shows 12.75"D x 13.5"W x 10"H. The model identity is not established (different model numbers may be involved), so no value was substituted or averaged. Recorded here so the discrepancy is not lost. The manufacturer URL is kept as plain text below because it is not an Amazon or government source and is not used as a data value anywhere on the site.
flags.action: Check the model number on the physical product or the manual, then choose one source of truth for dimensions.
